metadata.title: $L^2$ Curvature Bounds on Ricci flows with bounded scalar curvature up to dimension 7
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we study Ricci flows with uniformly bounded scalar curvature. On such Ricci flows we establish uniform $L^2$ Riemannian curvature bounds and $L^4$ Ricci curvature bounds up to dimension 7. These estimates improves $L^{2-\varepsilon}$ curvature bounds established by Bamler and $L^2$ curvature bounds in dimension 4 established by Bamler and Zhang. More generally, we establish uniform $L^2$ curvature bounds on $n$-manifolds satisfying an integral $L^p$ Ricci curvature bound for $p> n/2$, a uniform volume lower bound, and a strong $\varepsilon$-regularity assumption. This result extends the celebrated $L^2$ curvature estimates of Jiang and Naber, which were established under pointwise two-sided Ricci curvature bounds. To overcome the lack of pointwise control, we develop an $L^p$ adaptation of the neck decomposition theorem and establish a superconvexity estimate for the curvature on neck regions. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our structural assumptions are dynamically natural on Ricci flows with bounded scalar curvature. As an application, by combining our estimate with the a priori $L^{4-\varepsilon}$ curvature radius bound of Ricci flow established by Bamler, we obtain uniform $L^2$ curvature bounds on Ricci flows with bounded scalar curvature of dimension $n \le 7$.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 在标量曲率一致有界的 Ricci 流中建立最高七维的 L² 全曲率与 L⁴ Ricci 曲率界
analysis.workSummary: 在紧 Ricci 流的标量曲率绝对值界与初始 Perelman 熵下界条件下，对 n≤7 证明后半时间区间各单位球上的 L² 全曲率、L⁴ Ricci 曲率界；一般 n 维版本改用 p>n/2 的积分 Ricci 界、非塌缩及强 ε 正则性。
analysis.breakthrough: 七维以内获得此前 L²⁻ε 估计所未及的端点 L² 界。
analysis.limitations: Ricci 流定理同时要求紧致性与熵下界；一般维数版本仍有非塌缩和强 ε 正则性条件。
